fact: On 13 March 2024 the Cabinet said the data classification law aims, among other things, to regulate the exchange of shared data between government bodies, and the Justice Minister said the draft had been sent to all ministries concerned for comments.
title: وزير العدل: ارسال مشروع قانون تصنيف البيانات للجهات المعنية لأخذ ملاحظاتهم
